decision: Operational six-phase partition of the eight archived technical intervals. Original dates are conserved. Biological development overlaps; this mutually exclusive partition is an analysis convention, not a claim of non-overlapping physiology or observed intermediate dates.

rationale.maize: R1 covers silking/flowering. R2 blister is allocated to early kernel development (REP), while R3 and R4_R5 cover subsequent milk/dough/dent filling. Starch accumulation can already begin in R2; the partition is operational. The lag-stage experimental window is not asserted to match R2 exactly. The additional maize REP hazard remains unassigned.
rationale.rice: BBCH 30 begins panicle initiation, the reproductive transition in IRRI descriptions. Allocate the entire BBCH_30_39 block to REP together with booting/heading, before FLO. VEG retains leaf development and tillering. No internal date is invented.
rationale.soybean: R5 through the archived R6_R7 interval represents filling up to the onset of maturity; R8 is the archived maturity/dry-down interval. The aggregate R6_R7 boundary does not resolve the exact observed R7 date. MAT is therefore the archived terminal maturity window, an explicitly estimated operational boundary.
